newsitem.title: FRANCE: Georgia's Sheverdnadze begins visit to France.
newsitem.headline: Georgia's Sheverdnadze begins visit to France.

text.p: Georgian President Eduard Sheverdnadze began on Monday a three-day visit to France for political and economic talks.
Sheverdnadze, warmly praised by French authorities for his democratic and economic reforms, was to have lunch with French President Jacques Chirac and meet Foreign Minister Herve de Charette.
He is due to meet French business leaders on Tuesday.

Diplomats said French leaders would tell Sheverdnadze they back Georgia's bid to join the 40-member Council of Europe, which monitors democracy on the continent, and wanted early ratification of the 1996 partnership agreement between the European Union and Georgia.
